title: Sierre-Zinal — official homepage (2027 edition)
claims: The site header for the next edition reads 'Sierre-Zinal 2027 Saturday, August 7'.
The homepage describes the race as '31 km, 2200 metres of ascent, 1100 metres of descent' in the Valais Alps.
The site's page titles call Sierre-Zinal 'the race of the five 4000'.
The French homepage describes the course as 'très engageant' (very demanding).
The French homepage states under 'Nos Labels': 'Sierre-Zinal fait partie des plus grands circuits mondiaux.'

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网英文首页与法文首页，抄录 2027 日期与赛道三组数字。官网语言选择默认法文，英文首页内容与法文一致。
